subject: Kickstart orientation — finalizing console & API enablement slot

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@clearwave.com>

Cc: ClearWave Onboarding <onboarding@clearwave.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickstart orientation — getting our week 1 slot

Hi Marcus / Camila,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited to move into the hands-on orientation. We want a combined console walkthrough + API enablement session so our devs can deploy a simple inference route and test embedding calls.

High-level asks:
- 90-minute live session (up to 2 hours ok)
- Brief network/IAM checklist first (we have strict allowlist windows)
- Sandbox creds + sample curl/python snippets

Availability from our side: Mon 11/16 10:00–13:00 PST (preferred), Wed 11/18 08:00–11:00 PST (backup).

Can you confirm which slot you can cover, and whether the prework pack should go to our security contact or the engineering leads?

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Head of Platform Integrations | ClearWave
Elena.Soto@clearwave.com

Attachment: ClearWave_Onboarding_Roster.xlsx (referenced)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickstart orientation — getting our week 1 slot

Hi Elena — great to hear. We can do Mon 11/16 and will plan for a 90-minute "Kickstart orientation":

Proposed flow (we'll share slides + hands-on notebooks ahead):
1) 15 min: quick network/IAM allowlist + keys checklist (Ben)
2) 30 min: console walkthrough — model catalog, pin/versioning, streaming (Camila)
3) 35–45 min: API enablement + sample integration (Marcus)
4) 10 min: Q&A / next steps / rollout plan

Action items for you before the session:
- Send network contact for allowlist window (we'll provide IPs + FQDN in network_whitelist.txt)
- Confirm which engineers will join (names + emails) so we can pre-provision sandbox creds

We'll attach a short prework PDF. If security team prefers, send prework to security@clearwave.com and cc your eng lead.

If Mon 11/16 10:00 PST works, I'll send a calendar invite and the GoTo link.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin

Thanks Tom — confirmed for Mon 11/16 at 10:00 PST. Calendar invite sent (please accept).

Quick answers to your asks:
- Recording & tokens: we will not use any production keys during the session; sandbox tokens are ephemeral (TTL 2 hours) and we redact all tokens in the recording.
- Rollout checklist: added a 10-minute annex at the end to cover cutover steps, expected throughput baselines, and suggested batching/quantization settings for cost control (Ben will cover).

I've attached the prework here and the allowlist file with Redwood IP ranges. Please forward the prework to your security lead and cc me so we can address questions ahead of the session.

See you Monday — we'll join from the Redwood SF office; Camila will lead the console portion and Ben will run the network checklist.

Best,
